featured_reviews.name: Azalea Xavier
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to this salon at 3:00 PM and called the hairstylist Umesh at 3:19 PM to check if he was available for a global hair colour and haircut. He confirmed he was available and said it would take around 2 hours. I clearly mentioned that I had limited time as I had work later.

After waiting for 30 minutes, I called again and he said he was still on his way. Even after 40 minutes, he hadn’t arrived, and I eventually had to leave the salon because I was getting late.

What’s worse is that he was completely unapologetic about wasting my time. I had already washed my hair and was waiting for the service that never happened.

This isn’t the first time this salon has delayed me, but this level of unprofessionalism and lack of courtesy is simply unacceptable. I’m extremely disappointed and won’t be returning.

featured_reviews.name: M3L
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got my nails done here and Pragati did a ok for the price. Pooja also did a good job with the head massage. However, during the steam treatment, the heat was so high that it ended up burning my hair — which I didn’t realize at the time.

When I went for a hair wash, Pragati told me that my hair was burnt due to my previous pre-lightening. When I checked, it was completely tangled. I panicked and asked them to condition it again, but I noticed they were using a very cheap conditioner. When I requested a better product, they initially said none was available. Only when I offered to pay for it did they give me a Matrix conditioner, and even then I was charged an extra ₹50.

A chunk of my hair came out in my hand, and I was extremely scared. I called the owner to inform them, but to my surprise he blamed it on “regular hair fall.” If that were true, I would’ve been bald by now.

The situation was not handled properly, and cheaper products were being used despite the service looking professional from the outside. The staff is good, but the quality of products and the way the issue was managed was disappointing.

Unfortunately, I will not be coming here again.

featured_reviews.name: Anthony D'silva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positive Points
1. The studio has an awesome ambiance, and the staff, especially Rizwan and Rehan, are skilled at creating hairstyles matching pictures of models or celebrities.
2. They provide helpful suggestions on what looks good, prioritizing customer satisfaction over simply making a profit.
3. Impressed by their honesty, as they advised against hair coloring due to potential damage, considering individual circumstances.
4. Overall, a good experience with staff performing their job exceptionally well.

Negative Points
1. The hand towels had a smelly issue, despite informing the owner about it. Suggested improvement: Ensure thorough washing and complete drying of towels to prevent unpleasant odors.
2. Inconsistent AC usage – initially, the salon was cool and comfortable, but later visits revealed the AC was often turned off. Consistent temperature control is essential for a pleasant customer experience.

Recommendation
Despite the mentioned improvements, I highly recommend the studio for excellent hair services, cut, and colors. The staff's expertise and customer care make it a reliable choice for enhancing your looks.
